values.DataCenterNotes: The pipeline connects the Mountain Valley Southgate project to Duke Energy Progress's new gas plant in Person County near Roxboro, and serves only that plant. A Canary Media report from February 2025 says the Person County plant is designed in part to meet rising demand expected from data centers and large new customers. No named data center customer was found.

verifications.note: North Carolina Newsline brief from February 2024 names the T15 Reliability Project and says it connects MVP Southgate with Duke Energy's planned new gas power plants near Roxboro.
Southern Alliance for Clean Energy primer says the T15 pipeline will supply Duke's proposed Roxboro gas plant and serves only one plant.
Canary Media says the new Person County gas plant is designed in part to meet rising demand expected from data centers and large new customers. The article does not use the word Roxboro in its text.

records.researcher_notes: The tie runs through the power plant. The pipeline serves Duke's new gas plant in Person County near Roxboro. Canary Media says that plant is meant in part for data center demand. The Canary Media article does not say Roxboro in its text, so the match rests on Person County and the second phase of the plant approved the year before. No named customer was found.

ledger.note: A very short lateral at the Mexico border crossing for liquefied natural gas exports. Treated as an export link. Searches in the prior pass found no data center tie and none was re-checked.

Searched the compressor project with power plants and data centers. Southern Star and trade press say the shippers are gas utilities and electric utilities in Missouri and Kansas, driven by coal retirements. No shipper or plant was named, and no data center was mentioned.

The pipeline serves the Evergy Viola plant. Searched Evergy's plant approval and large load coverage. Evergy talks about data center load across its system, and the Kansas approval coverage does not tie Viola to a data center or a named customer.
A local gas utility expansion serving homes, schools, and businesses in Spring Creek, Nevada. Two searches and utility filings found no data center or large commercial load tie.
